title: Mercy in Cruauté
warnings: Creator Chose Not To Use Archive Warnings
summary:
Harry finds in the trees the answer to a question he didn't realized mattered; he then recalls a tradition, an act of love and devotion between two souls. He looks at Kim, seeking another answer; will his partner accept his *demande*?
"This is nonsense, but poetic nonsense. Hopefully it makes a difference in Kim's eyes."
bookmark_notes:
“ How fucking lovely it is to be devoted to somebody good. ”
“ Devastation is a gorgeous color on his skin, and cities have fallen for lesser beauties than his in the past. Should you tell him all that? ”
“ He uses your name in gentle mockery and because you both like the sound of it in his mouth. ”
“ "Would you be insulted if I wore my ring under my glove?" So it would only be his, and only be yours.”
